info.name: Returns a list of Aggregated Usages

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Subscription ID is an identifier associated with the service, used for filtering the computed usage in SPM.

params.name: timeFrom
params.description: Initial date to filter computed usage data in SPM. For non-aggregated data, the time period between fromDate and toDate, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.

params.name: timeTo
params.description: Final date to filter computed usage data in SPM, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.

params.name: parentProduct
params.description: Product part number for the subscribed service line, referred to as the parent product.

params.name: grouping
params.description: Grouping criteria to use for aggregating the computed usage, whether hourly (`HOURLY`), daily (`DAILY`), monthly (`MONTHLY`), or none (`NONE`), so as not to follow a grouping criteria by date.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of aggregatedComputedUsages items to return within the Subscription "List" call, this 
counts the overall count across all items.
Example: `500`

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

items.docs: Collection API that returns a list of aggregated computed usage details (there can be multiple parent products under a given SubID, each of which is represented under the subscription service line # in SPM).

info.name: Returns a list of Computed Usages and its associated cost

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Subscription ID is an identifier associated with the service, used for filtering the computed usage in SPM.

params.name: timeFrom
params.description: Initial date to filter computed usage data in SPM. For non-aggregated data, the time period between fromDate and toDate, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.

params.name: timeTo
params.description: Final date to filter computed usage data in SPM, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.

params.name: parentProduct
params.description: Product part number for the subscribed service line, called the parent product.

params.name: computedProduct
params.description: Product part number for the computed usage.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call. Default: (`50`)

Example: '500'

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending ('ASC') or descending ('DESC').

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. You can provide one sort order (`sortOrder`).

items.docs: Collection API that returns a list of computed usages for the given filters.

info.name: Returns Computed Usage Details corresponding to the Compute Usage id passed

params.name: computedUsageId
params.description: The computed usage ID.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: fields
params.description:
Partial response refers to an optimization technique offered
by the RESTful web APIs, to return only the information 
(fields) required by the client. This parameter controls which fields to
return.

items.docs: Returns computed usage corresponding to the passed ID.
